author: Davidgo5867

english.text: We all have to study math in school at one time or another. And many of us have wondered: will this stuff be useful afterward, in real life? Mathematicians Keith Devlin and Gary Lorden answer an emphatic "yes". In their new book, The Numbers Behind "Numb3rs," they argue that math is especially useful in the science of crime-solving: the subject of the popular TV show, Numb3rs. The authors make the case that the stories on the show might be fictional, but the critical role of math is very real.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jiu3 hai2 hok6 haau6 duk6 sou3 hok6，ji4 ngo5 dei6 dong1 zung1 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 nam2：ni1 di1 je5 zi1 hau6 wui5 m4 wui5 hai2 jin6 sat6 sang1 wut6 jap6 min6 jau5 jung6？sou3 hok6 gaa1 gei1 si1 · dak1 fu1 lam4 tung4 gaa1 lei5 · lok3 dang1 koeng4 diu6「hai6」。hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 syu1《 Numb3rs bui3 hau6 ge3 sou3 zi6》jap6 min6，keoi5 dei6 jing6 wai4 sou3 hok6 hai2 gaai2 kyut3 faan6 zeoi6 ge3 fo1 hok6 jap6 min6 dak6 bit6 jau5 jung6：jit6 mun2 din6 si6 zit3 muk6《 Numb3rs 》ge3 zyu2 tai4 zok3 ze2 jing6 wai4 ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 jap6 min6 ge3 gu3 si6 ho2 nang4 hai6 heoi1 kau3 ge3，daan6 hai6 sou3 hok6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 zok3 jung6 hai6 fei1 soeng4 zan1 sat6。
text: 我哋每個人都要喺學校讀數學，而我哋當中好多人都會諗：呢啲嘢之後會唔會喺現實生活入面有用？數學家基斯 · 德夫林同加里 · 洛登強調「係」。喺佢哋嘅新書《 Numb3rs 背後嘅數字》入面，佢哋認為數學喺解決犯罪嘅科學入面特別有用：熱門電視節目《 Numb3rs 》嘅主題作者認為呢個節目入面嘅故事可能係虛構嘅，但係數學嘅重要作用係非常真實。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Most people, if you describe a train of events to them, will tell you what the result would be. They can put those events together in their minds, and argue from them that something will come to pass. There are few people, however, who, if you told them a result, would be able to evolve from their own inner consciousness what the steps were which led up to that result. This power is what I mean when I talk of reasoning backwards, or analytically.

jyutping: daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hoeng3 keoi5 dei6 miu4 seot6 jat1 lin4 cyun3 ge3 si6 gin6，keoi5 dei6 wui5 waa6 nei5 zi1 git3 gwo2 wui5 hai6 dim2。keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 ni1 di1 si6 gin6 fong3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6，jin4 hau6 cung4 zung1 leon6 zing3 ceot1 jau5 di1 je5 wui5 faat3 sang1，daan6 hai6，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 waa6 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 jat1 go3 git3 gwo2，hou2 siu2 jan4 wui5 nang4 gau3 cung4 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 noi6 sam1 ji3 sik1 jap6 min6 zeon3 faa3 ceot1 dou6 zi3 ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 ge3 bou6 zaau6 hai6 me1。
text: 大部分人，如果你向佢哋描述一連串嘅事件，佢哋會話你知結果會係點。佢哋可以將呢啲事件放喺佢哋嘅腦海入面，然後從中論證出有啲嘢會發生，但係，如果你話畀佢哋知一個結果，好少人會能夠從佢哋自己嘅內心意識入面進化出導致呢個結果嘅步驟係咩。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's a sunny 26th of July of 2025, here on Lulu Island. As usual, I walk to, drink at, and snack at Tim Hortons café. In the morning there, I was talking to Gary the Cantonese. He knows that I lived in Japan before. He wants to visit. I recommended to him "one week in Tokyo and one week in Okinawa." We both agreed that what makes a place special is really the food. We both agreed that Japan is much like Thailand. We talked about World War II: In the Philippines, my mother was a little girl, to whom a Japanese soldier gave little toys like a toy chick and promised that he would marry her when she grew up upon his return. Gary talked about family members who had to swim across the river to get to another place in "Occupied Hong Kong." I didn't mention to him about my fantasies about the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere or "Dai Tōa Kyōeiken" in an alternative reality. Yesterday, I went to South Arm Park to view the forest. There was a colourful ice cream truck roving around, blaring the tune of "Music Box Dancer" by Frank Mills.

jyutping: 2025 nin4 7 jyut6 26 hou6，tin1 hei3 cing4 long5，hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2。 ngo5 jat1 jyu4 gei3 wong5 gam2 haang4 heoi3、hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 je5 tung4 maai4 sik6 ling4 sik6。 hai2 go2 dou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 tung4 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 Gary king1 gan2 git6。 keoi5 zi1 dou3 ngo5 zi1 cin4 zyu6 gwo3 jat6 bun2。 keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 taam3 fong2。 ngo5 hoeng3 keoi5 teoi1 zin3「dung1 ging1 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3，cung1 sing4 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3」。 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 tung4 ji3，ling6 dou3 jat1 go3 dei6 fong1 dak6 bit6 ge3 zan1 zing3 hai6 sik6 mat6。 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 tung4 ji3 jat6 bun2 tung4 taai3 gwok3 hou2 ci5。 ngo5 dei6 gong2 zo2 dai6 ji6 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3：hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1，ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai6 go3 sai3 lou6 neoi2，jau5 go3 jat6 bun2 gwan1 jan4 bei2 zo2 di1 hou2 ci5 wun6 geoi6 siu2 gai1 gam2 ge3 siu2 wun6 geoi6 bei2 keoi5，bing6 daap3 jing3 maai4 keoi5 faan1 lai4 zi1 hau6，keoi5 wui5 hai2 keoi5 daai6 go3 zo2 zi1 hau6 tung4 keoi5 git3 fan1。 Gary gong2 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4 jiu3 jau4 gwo3 ho4 sin1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 dou3「zim3 ling5 hoeng1 gong2」ge3 ling6 jat1 go3 dei6 fong1。 ngo5 mou5 tung4 keoi5 tai4 gwo3 ngo5 deoi3 daai6 dung1 aa3 gung6 tung4 faan4 wing4 hyun1 waak6 ze2 ling6 leoi6 jin6 sat6 jap6 min6 ge3「daai6 dung1 ging1 jin4」ge3 waan6 soeng2。 kam4 jat6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 naam4 bei3 gung1 jyun2 tai2 sam1 lam4。 jau5 gaa3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 ge3 syut3 gou1 ce1 zau1 wai4 jau4 zau2，ceoi1 gan2 Frank Mills ge3《jam1 ngok6 hap2 mou5 ze2》ge3 kuk1 diu6。
text: 2025年7月26號，天氣晴朗，喺呢度露露島。 我一如既往噉行去、喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳飲嘢同埋食零食。 喺嗰度嘅朝早，我同香港人 Gary 傾緊偈。 佢知道我之前住過日本。 佢想去探訪。 我向佢推薦「東京一個禮拜，沖繩一個禮拜」。 我哋兩個都同意，令到一個地方特別嘅真正係食物。 我哋兩個都同意日本同泰國好似。 我哋講咗第二次世界大戰：喺菲律賓，我阿媽係個細路女，有個日本軍人畀咗啲好似玩具小雞噉嘅小玩具畀佢，並答應埋佢返嚟之後，佢會喺佢大個咗之後同佢結婚。 Gary 講到屋企人要游過河先可以去到「佔領香港」嘅另一個地方。 我冇同佢提過我對大東亞共同繁榮圈或者另類現實入面嘅「大東京研」嘅幻想。 琴日，我去咗南臂公園睇森林。 有架五顏六色嘅雪糕車周圍遊走，吹緊 Frank Mills 嘅《音樂盒舞者》嘅曲調。
